overview: EasyBuy is an Expo React Native ecommerce app with shopper and admin flows. The mobile app uses React Navigation for auth, tab, shopper, profile, and admin screens; Redux stores the cart; a centralized API layer targets either the real Node backend or the local Express mock server.

domain_models.name: User
domain_models.definition: Authenticated account returned by login or registration, carrying identity, email, token, and userType values that drive shopper versus admin navigation.

domain_models.name: Admin
domain_models.definition: Privileged userType that can view dashboard statistics and manage users, products, categories, and order status.

domain_models.name: Customer
domain_models.definition: Regular shopper userType that browses products and categories, manages profile and wishlist, places orders, and reviews order history.

domain_models.name: Product
domain_models.definition: Sellable catalog item with title, SKU, price, quantity, description, image, and category information.

domain_models.name: Category
domain_models.definition: Catalog grouping for products, represented by an id, title, description, and icon/image assets.

domain_models.name: CartItem
domain_models.definition: Client-side Redux representation of a selected product, preserving product metadata plus available quantity and selected quantity.

domain_models.name: Order
domain_models.definition: Checkout result containing line items, amount, discount, cash-on-delivery payment type, shipping address fields, status, and timestamps.

domain_models.name: WishlistItem
domain_models.definition: Saved product reference for a customer wishlist, managed through dedicated backend operations.

domain_models.name: Session
domain_models.definition: Persisted authenticated user and token stored through SecureStore on native platforms and AsyncStorage on web.

domain_models.name: Upload
domain_models.definition: Product or category image asset submitted as multipart form data and served back through the backend uploads endpoint.
